MOOVICUT AGENT GUIDE

PURPOSE
Moovicut prepares an editable storyboard and shot list. It does not generate video. The website UI is in English and Portuguese. Chinese, French, Japanese, and Italian are not site languages. The header stores the choice as moovicut.language. ?lang= is the shareable form, and English omits it. Fixed prompt lines follow the site language. Optional promptLanguage defaults to en on the API, and JSON field names stay English. Detection is rule-based and does not call a model. Nothing is sent to an external AI.

README
The project README is a page at /readme and raw Markdown at /README.md. The agent skill is a page at /skill and raw Markdown at /SKILL.md. Credits and the CC BY-SA 4.0 compilation licence for the place library are at /credits.

PLACE LIBRARY
Places come from the static file app/data/place-lexicon.json. A sure place can name the setting when it appears. An ambiguous word counts only in a locative. A scene keeps its place until a new locative sentence, a beat whose subject names a new place, or a movement such as crosses, wades into, goes to, returns to, boards, pilots, caminha até, volta a, pilota, embarca, or vai para replaces it. A compound place keeps the full phrase. Leaving an interior with no new destination returns to the previous outdoor place. Walking from a stage or palco into snow or water leaves that stage. Sea and beach stay different places. A watch is never a place. A sentence where someone enters also replaces the place. The place is the first noun after that preposition, kept even when it is not in the library, and the shot is flagged. A passing mention does not. An adjective, a garment, and a possessive are never the place. A held, worn, or used noun is never the place, and a person's name wins over a place word. The file is CC BY-SA 4.0 because it includes OpenWN-PT. Sources: Princeton WordNet, Open Multilingual Wordnet, and OpenWN-PT (CC BY-SA).

BROWSER AUTOMATION
The open studio page (`/studio`) exposes window.Shotboard (window.Moovicut is the same object). Use capabilities() to inspect supported actions and getProject() to read the current project. createProject({ premise, model }) creates a storyboard. updateShot(id, patch), reorderShot(id, direction) and deleteShot(id) edit the board. exportJSON() returns a portable project document. This is an in-page API. The public network API is separate and stateless.

DEFAULT BOARD
A new board is 5 scenes × 3 seconds (15s total) unless shots, duration, or scenes say otherwise. A story longer than 40 shots is split into parts of at most 40 shots. The same character sheet and place sheet are reused across parts, so continuity holds. The response includes parts. 30s is 10 × 3s. 60s is 20 × 3s. Step-by-step mode in /studio edits each scene. Agents pass the same controls to POST /api/v1/storyboard or the MCP tool plan_storyboard.

REMOTE API
POST /api/v1/storyboard accepts premise, model, shots, mode or sequenceMode, continuity, density, prompt_style (short or detailed; short is the default per-shot video prompt: framing, the named action, the full lock line, the place, one light, and locked-off camera unless a movement was set, and the lock version in force is pasted unchanged; detailed keeps the full sheet and that same version), optional promptLanguage or prompt_language (en or pt; omitted means en), aspectRatio, genre, style, duration, compact, an optional scenes array, a scenario object or text, input "prose" only when the premise names nobody, and the light presets ad, series, and explainer. A story that names people is sent as scenario character sheets: age, every garment, carried items, distinctive features, and locks with fromOrder. format agent on prose returns HTTP 200 with sheets_missing and sheets to resubmit. Free prose is split on place and time cues unless splitScenes is false. The current firm place wins, and a sentence with no listed verb is kept. An article inside a venue name is not a place cue. The cuts array gives each cue and reason. A detected character with no look is a warning, not a 400. A sentence that only describes a person, a place, or the time fills that context and is not a shot. Age and a carried item stay in the lock line. The object of a carry, hand, pick-up, or drop verb starts an item version when it is any concrete noun, such as a letter, a pastry, a key, or a basket, in English or Portuguese. An abstract noun or a place is not an item. A note such as coat removed removes only that garment, and puts on X adds only that garment. A takes off, tira, or despe that the version already applied does not raise undeclared_wardrobe. The appearance phrase is complete, it does not end on a preposition, and matching is on word boundaries. A Portuguese role keeps the gender written in the text. Portuguese night and evening cues set night light from that sentence until the next time cue. An explicit morning or dawn cue replaces that night. A language, a body part, a room surface, an object, and a clothing phrase are never places, and a rejected candidate is not carried. A movement into a new location adopts the noun phrase even when it is not in the lexicon. One action beat is one shot. Count the actions and do not merge or drop one. Send the whole scenario in one request. A scene `time` of dawn, morning, midday, afternoon, dusk, evening, or night drives the light line and carries forward. evening, morning, afternoon, and midday in light are stored as time. A warning action of none is informational and the board is done. Any re-post must resend every scene. List only the people in that shot, set light on every shot, and split a story over 40 shots into parts. A scenario that packs many actions into few shots is HTTP 400 invalid_plan. A story with no named place still plans, and that place is marked uncertain. Time of day applies from the sentence that states it, forward only. A later first name aliases the full name. A place noun used only as an object does not move the scene. An explicit names-only scenario is still 400. Scenario mode stores characters, places, and light once, resolves them in each generated prompt, packs 15–60s sequences, and warns from 6,000 characters (hard cap 8,000). Style families are anime (manga is an alias), cinema, and documentary, and they lock the style in every mode, including a plain premise. An unknown family is 400. A shot marked promptEdited, including a client prompt or a posted shotboard.compact.v1 board, is kept unless overwritePrompt is true. Series is 3 to 8 episodes and three shots each, so the default of 3 episodes is 9 shots. The rate limit uses Railway's X-Real-IP, ignores X-Forwarded-For, and counts across connections. A repeated model warning such as Sora's long-clip note is returned once per board. Ad turns product and benefit into hook, hero, proof, and pack shot, with the product locked on the film sheet. Series plans 3 to 8 vertical episodes on one film sheet. Explainer turns a numbered list into one action per shot and snaps duration to the selected model profile. A premise that does not use the Name, trait, trait shape is not turned into a scenario. A premise that names people or several actions, and that cannot be planned into those shots, is HTTP 400 invalid_plan, not a template board. Characters, places, and scenes sent at the top level, instead of inside `scenario`, are HTTP 400 `misplaced_scenario_fields`. The message names each field and shows a short example. That error outranks `invalid_premise` when the premise is missing. Scene `what` and `who` count toward `invalid_plan`. Age and role stay in the character lock line. A constraint such as "without touching", "不接触", or "sem se tocar" stays in the short prompt and the detailed prompt. A shot size already written in the action is used once, and the response adds a `shot_size_in_action` warning. The message names every dropped person and quotes every dropped action, each one ending in a period (`This action was not planned: "Maya hands Rui a letter on the quay".`). Send a scenario. who and w accept a string or a list of names. A wrong shape says that a string or a list of names is expected. format agent warns with empty_characters or empty_places when that list is empty, and with empty_who or empty_where on a scenario shot. A Chinese short prompt names the subject, then the place with 在, then the action, with no full stop between the name and the verb. A body part, a garment, or a similar noun is never a place. That shape keeps the named people, splits look and outfit, and uses the real action sentences as shots. input prose reads English, Simplified Chinese, and Portuguese. It does not call a model, and nothing is sent to an external AI. It returns those shots, or HTTP 400 with error and a message that lists each missing piece. A names-only scenario object is 400 and the message names each missing field. splitActions defaults to true and splits a multi-action shot; false keeps it in one shot. format agent includes warnings when a shot looks risky. He walks away is one action and is not too_many_actions. A scene whose only names are public figures, brands, or trademarks returns the neutral risk note and does not add missing-character or missing-place lines. regenerateShot plus project rebuilds one shot and leaves the others unchanged. warnings is omitted when empty and never blocks the board. Every mode shares one film sheet, and switching modes keeps it. format "agent" returns shotboard.compact.v1. Minified JSON, with no extra whitespace, is the token-efficient way to send that compact document. A scenario may omit premise; the idea line is then the character and place names, not the first scene's action. A browser library can export characters, places, and styles. model accepts grok, google, sora, chatgpt, midjourney, hailuo, seedance, pika, kling, runway, luma, wan, or generic. A full response includes modelProfile with the cited sources. Veo accepts 4, 6, or 8 seconds and 16:9 or 9:16. Values the official page does not state are marked unverified. Sources for the profiles added on 2026-11-16 are in docs/model-profiles.md. compact:true or ?compact=1 returns title, premise, model, aspectRatio, studioUrl, and shots of order, duration, and prompt. studioUrl is a /studio#board= link. The hash is not stored.GET /openapi.json is the OpenAPI 3.1 document.
POST /mcp is stateless MCP (initialize, tools/list, tools/call). Tools: plan_storyboard, export_prompts, validate_storyboard. GET /mcp describes it. /.well-known/mcp.json is discovery.
POST /a2a is A2A v0.3 over JSON-RPC 2.0: one method, message/send. A text part is the story; a data part is the full request, or {tool, args} for one of the three tools. The reply is an agent message: a shotboard data part plus a one-line text summary. Named planner errors come back as JSON-RPC error data (error, errors) so the repair prompt survives the transport. No streaming, no task state, nothing stored. The card is /.well-known/agent-card.json.
GET /agents and /agents.md explain when to use each one.
No API key. 30 requests per minute per IP. No database. Premises are not stored.
Custom scenes example:
{"premise":"A lighthouse keeper races the dusk to repair a failing beacon.","model":"grok","scenes":[{"action":"Wide view of the lighthouse at dusk","duration":3,"camera":"Slow push-in","lighting":"Blue hour"},{"action":"Close on the keeper repairing the lens","duration":4,"notes":"Wind on the gallery"}]}

CLI
node cli/moovicut.mjs --premise "A lighthouse keeper races the dusk." --model google --output storyboard.json
node cli/moovicut.mjs --premise "A lighthouse keeper races the dusk." --model google --shots 4 --duration 3 --output storyboard.json
node cli/moovicut.mjs --input storyboard.json --export-prompts
The shotboard command runs the same program. Omitting --shots and --duration plans 5 scenes of 3 seconds.

DOCUMENT CONTRACT
The flat shotboard.v1 document includes id, title, premise, model/target_model, aspectRatio and shots. Each shot includes a stable id/shot_id, numeric order, framing, lens, camera, action, lighting, sound, continuity, duration/duration_seconds and prompt. Preserve user-edited prompt text when reordering. Validate imported documents. Do not send prompts to a model unless the person chooses to paste them.

LOCAL STORAGE
Projects are stored in the current browser. JSON export is the portable backup. The studio can save a shotboard.backup.v1 library of projects on this device and restore that file after it validates. Browser storage failures must be reported, never hidden behind a success message.

PRICE
The prompts work with Grok Imagine, Google, or any other AI image or video model. Grok Imagine and Google are prompt targets in the picker, not bundled generation. Planning, editing, and JSON export are free. There is no subscription. Optional tips open https://buymeacoffee.com/enzoc1977r in a new tab. Moovicut does not take payment itself.

LIMITS
No account, no cross-device sync, and no video rendering inside Moovicut. The site is in English.
